traits.leaf_life_years.note: Festuca orthophylla, the one fescue whose leaf life was found measured (Monteiro 2012, as search results quote the thesis; the text itself was not read): a leaf lives 141 days on average on a tussock's outer tillers and 169 on its central ones, about two leaf turnovers a year, on tussocks of about 3200 tillers, 56% of them alive. Read as 0.39 to 0.46 years for the genus until its own species are measured.
